ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels dominate the central regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and both distal tips. A dense region of dark mottling is located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe, with more dispersed dark spotting in the central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitude is most significant on the outer lateral portions of both lobes, with 6-8 distinct sharp protrusions visible on the left lobe's upper edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory for the main body of both lobes, transitioning to a sharp concave inward sweep at the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular brownish-white pixels (barnacle colonies) are localized on the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions visible; specifically, three parallel diagonal rake marks on the medial white section of the left lobe and one prominent vertical linear mark on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; a distinct dark circular ring-shaped mark is visible in the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe's white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'O-shaped' pigmentation or scar mark centered in the white field of the right lobe lobe.
